usage: the engine applies these rules in order; a declared rule from the case file (for example R010) is honoured with its human_gate

rules.condition: the material name is a known alias
rules.transform: map to the canonical material name
rules.failure_mode: the same material entered twice under two names

rules.condition: the indicator spelling is a variant
rules.failure_mode: the same indicator split across field names

rules.condition: a numeric value carries trailing zeros
rules.transform: strip trailing zeros; keep a range verbatim; leave a held value empty
rules.failure_mode: a spurious precision difference hiding a real one

rules.condition: the unit token is a known unit
rules.transform: map to the canonical unit form
rules.failure_mode: a case difference read as a different unit

rules.condition: the unit token is arbitrary or unresolvable
rules.transform: hold the row for a human; never convert

hold_tokens.note: an unreported value is held, never filled with a guess
